note: The verifier's protected KDA specification: the loaded-layer correctness schedule, the timing validity and pairing policy, the binding observation and the GDN preservation cases. Moved unchanged from the evaluation tree's protocol.json; the seeds are config.json's (infb.kda.seed, infb.kda.gdn_seed). Never shipped to the agent. The mathematics schedule carries a case manifest (ids, rows, history, steps, seed offsets, layers, ranks) and the fresh length-one case; metadata names the native-metadata schedules.

mathematics.initial_state: zero and valid nonzero history for every length, one included; a valid row continues history_tokens earlier tokens, a fresh row has none
mathematics.case_to_layer: case i runs on loaded KDA layer i modulo 20; split case i on layer i
mathematics.manifest_note: the cases keep their order, seeds (seed + 73 i) and layers; the fresh length-one case is appended as case 20, for 21 cases plus three splits. Every case runs on all four TP ranks.

timing.paired_comparison: median reference time / median candidate time, per family, on the same host

host_canary.rule: each family is bracketed by host canary readings; a bracket more than the tolerance below the baseline reading is invalid; an invalid family is measured once more, and a second invalid bracket asks for a rerun and never decides a verdict

timing.stop_rule: a candidate axis stops after a fully measured family whose paired verdict fails; families not reached are recorded as not measured, blocked by that failure

binding.launch: a separate fresh server that the private serve wrapper launches at the recipe with the binding instrumentation installed through its worker extension; never timed
binding.workload: 16 decode tokens after a 512-token prompt, then eight 64-token streams overlapping three 2,048-token prefills of eight tokens each, injected after real decode tokens arrive
binding.baseline: two matched repetitions of a 129-token prompt generating 16 tokens
binding.interventions: for each of the 20 layers: output scaled by 0, and 8.0 added to the recurrent state written after the call
binding.traces: one complete profiler trace from every rank, with native prefill and mixed markers on every layer and graph replay

gdn.initial_state: zero and nonzero for every packed case; ordinary batch-two prefill with nonzero state for the single lengths
gdn.decode_slots: sparse odd-numbered slots; every unused slot must stay bit-identical

metadata.note: The native-metadata schedules of test_native_state_metadata_and_replay, run by metadata.py through the private RPC infb_kda_metadata. Lengths, counts, populations and extents are fixed; seeds are the component seeds; each case seed is the component seed plus SHA256 of its name (metadata.case_seed), which also orders its slot permutation and validity draws.
metadata.mixed_validity_slots: distinct odd (nonadjacent) slots in a seeded order; every slot of the region holds finite nonzero stale state

turnover.rule: valid history in slots 1, 5 and 9 beside a request in slot 3; the owners of 1, 5 and 9 are released and fresh one-token requests take 9, 1 and 5 in that order, interleaved with the still-live request continuing in slot 3; then every row continues once more

branch.rule: a fresh 96-token prefix in slot 2, its four state views copied into slots 7 and 13; branch 7 then branch 13 with different suffixes, then each branch revisited for one token; slot 2 must stay unchanged

replay.rule: per population: one-token rows in seeded slots of 1..72 with seeded validity; every builder staged as the runner stages a step; the population layer's graph of the smallest captured extent at least the population replayed; population 0 is the runner's dummy forward (capture-entry staging, every row on the null block)

metadata.layers: mixed validity, turnover and branch on all 20 loaded layers for both seeds; replay populations then checkpoint splits on one cyclic layer counter, seed-major, covering every layer once

deployments.dp2: replay on each replica, (dp, tp) ranks (0..1, 0..3)
